name: Marais Temps Clair-Mississippi River
places: Rivers Pointe Fire and Rescue Station 2
New Town At St Charles Recreation Area
about: Marais Temps Clair-Mississippi River drains about 72 square miles, 78% of it in St. Charles County. The land ranges from about 840 feet above sea level at its highest point to about 420 feet at its lowest. Its main stream is Mason Chute. St. Charles County communities here include St. Charles, Portage Des Sioux and West Alton. Downstream, its water passes through the City of Alton-Mississippi River and City of Wood River-Mississippi River watersheds on its way down the Mississippi River.
